finalResult.currentParagraphText: “I guess I can’t get rid of you entirely quite yet, huh,” Jake muttered semi-jokingly. “I assume you’re also going?”
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Of course,” Jacob nodded before letting out a sad sigh. “I will miss Earth, but I also know going there would only be cause for trouble.”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “The Andromeda Galaxy has, for all intents and purposes, been wholly taken over by the Holy Church. Even before the Prima Guardian event, it was mostly conquered using the Prima Alliance system, and after the system event, I believe the takeover will be complete,” Jacob explained. “Some other factions do also retain a presence there, but the one officially ruling everything will be the Holy Church, of that there is no doubt.”
